summary: The Claude readiness grace can be shortened with ST3_CLAUDE_READINESS_GRACE_MS so the hookless readiness tests do not wait the full 15 s; the default is unchanged

replay.detail: No stored history or replay change.

schema.detail: No database, claim or configuration schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: The variable can only shorten the 15 s default; unset, behavior is identical.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the variable; nothing stored depends on it.
